BoM series DMQaQc.Merged.DailyMean.24HR, ts_id 286878010, station 414203 MURRAY @ EUSTON; data owner VIC - Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action (Bureau of Meteorology).
Daily mean of the merged quality-controlled record, computed by BoM over 24 hours; the API does not say how many readings fed each early-year mean (Bureau of Meteorology).

Quality codes (10 quality-A best available Quality; 90 quality-B compromised; 110 quality-C estimate; 140 quality-E unknown): counts {10: 17379, 90: 46, 110: 983, 140: 267}. A and B (compromised) are measured, C (estimate) estimated, and E (unknown quality) measured before 1991 and provisional from 1991 on (267 days), where it marks recent unchecked values (Bureau of Meteorology).
Share of days with code E (unknown quality) by decade: {2010: 0.021, 2020: 0.077}; with code B (compromised): {1990: 0.004, 2000: 0.0, 2010: 0.002, 2020: 0.01} (Bureau of Meteorology).
Dropped: 4 empty timestamps, 0 values coded F (missing or incorrect) and 0 negative values (Bureau of Meteorology).
